ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity (white) pixels to 20% low-intensity (black/dark) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, contiguous white geometric fields occupying the majority of the left and right lobes. A thick, continuous black border lines the trailing edges and distal tips. A central vertical dark band bisects the fluke at the peduncle junction. Scattered low-intensity pixel clusters are present within the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 45-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, multi-scale serration pattern along the entire trailing edge, featuring irregular peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex curve along the superior boundary of both lobes, tapering sharply to pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several small, dark, circular ring-like clusters on the right lobe and sparse dark focal spots on the medial portion of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct complex of curved, reddish-hued linear pixel disruptions on the medial-superior section of the left lobe. Dark, short linear streaks are visible near the distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent reddish-brown pigmented scars/lesions on the left lobe, exhibiting a non-standard color profile for the species.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique reddish-pigmented markings on the left lobe that contrast sharply with the standard black-and-white fluke topography.
